Specification: This module specifies a very small consensus-style system in which a single state variable `chosen` starts as the empty set and, in one step, may become a singleton set containing some value from the constant set `Value`. The safety property proves that `chosen` is always a finite subset of `Value` with cardinality at most 1, and the liveness property proves that under weak fairness of `Next`, the system eventually chooses a value provided `Value` is nonempty. The file is a translated TLA+ spec with TLAPS proofs, using finite-set cardinality facts and temporal reasoning to establish invariance, enabledness, eventual success, and an equivalence characterization of the live specification.
